decisions.reason: As a close-to-core handle family that survived the initial market test, it likely has revealed enough demand and costs little to keep within the firm's broad architectural fittings portfolio.

This design appears to have passed the early screening stage, and although a single design is easier to rationalize than a full family, its fit with the firm's design-led core range still favors keeping it.

Because this electronic access system is a flagship product aligned with the firm's strategic move toward integrated digital building solutions, management would be inclined to keep the option open and continue backing it.
